scope: Front-only static style study: same dwarf, underwear and work tunic; game integration pending style review
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a FRONT VIEW style study for a 2D dwarf colony simulation game. Exactly TWO full pawn icons side by side, the SAME middle-aged adult male fantasy dwarf with the same face, hair, beard, silhouette and scale. Left wears opaque cream boxer underwear and has a plain peach torso. Right wears a muted teal work tunic with a simple brown belt and small square brass buckle.
Strongly simplified flat 2D game art, designed to stay readable at 48-64 pixels tall: solid clean color shapes, consistent bold dark outlines, at most ONE small flat shadow per material. NO realistic painting, gradients, material textures, skin pores, muscle marks, chest anatomy, fabric folds, metallic shine or sculpted 3D lighting. Face has two tiny dark eyes with NO eye whites, thick short angular eyebrows, a broad simple bulb-shaped nose indicated with just outline and one flat tone, small ears. Brown hair is 4-5 chunky silhouette shapes, gray beard is ONE compact angular mass with only two internal dividing lines, no individual hair strands. Mature sturdy dwarf character, calm slightly stern expression, not a baby or a big-eyed doll.
VERY IMPORTANT silhouette: only a head overlapping one continuous compact broad torso token. NO arms, hands, shoulders protruding like cut-off arms, legs, feet, boots or tools. Body sides flow smoothly into a SINGLE broad rounded bottom, no leg split or two foot-like lobes. Underwear is a plain cream band covering lower quarter of the same continuous torso shape, with no anatomy or bulge. Work tunic has exactly the same body silhouette and simply replaces the torso surface. Head itself occupies roughly 40 percent of total pawn height, body 60 percent with overlap; head width around 85 percent of torso width. Beard overlaps upper torso a little. Both characters upright, identical front-facing neutral posture, no visible neck gap. No ground shadows.
Composition: landscape 1024x768, left pawn centered around x300 and right pawn around x724, generous empty margin on all sides, equal baseline, icons roughly 430px high. Plain solid warm pale gray background #e7e2d5. No labels, letters, logos, panels, props or other characters. Original dwarf designs, minimal colony-game pawn visual language.
